commit.message:
fix: reset maskLen per row in QuantizeForSumVf and InverseQuantizeVf

UpdateMask consumes maskLen during inner loop iteration, leaving it
at 0 or a residual value for subsequent rows. This caused incorrect
mask behavior when rowLen > 1 in the deterministic scatter_nd_add path.

Changes:
- QuantizeForSumVf: rename param maskLen -> afterAxis, reassign
  maskLen = afterAxis at the start of each row loop
- InverseQuantizeVf: rename param maskLen -> colLen, reassign
  maskLen = colLen at the start of each row loop
